prompt: A game art part sheet shows one young western dragon taken apart into six separate pieces laid out in a tidy grid with clear gaps between them: the head with two swept-back horns, the torso, one front leg, one hind leg, the tail with a spade tip, and one folded bat-like wing. Every piece is drawn in side view facing right, with emerald green scales painted as overlapping plates and pale gold undersides. It is a hand-painted 2D game creature sprite with a clean dark outline, cel shading in two shadow tones, and a soft rim of warm light from the upper left so the body reads as round and solid. Proportions are stylised with a large head, a compact body and chunky claws, and large bright eyes give it a bold, friendly look. The pieces sit apart from each other with space between every one. Plain flat solid magenta background, nothing else behind the subject.
